decision_definitions.admitted: All hard gates pass for the declared field ownership and an ingestion-ready frozen release exists.
decision_definitions.pilot_only: The source may enter only a bounded private pilot after the named pilot-adapter prerequisite gates pass; every remaining gate must pass before admission or public claims.
decision_definitions.private_only: Curators may consult the source, but it may not populate public claims.
decision_definitions.deferred: No ingestion or adapter work until a named unresolved gate is satisfied.
decision_definitions.rejected: The source is outside the workflow under current terms or scientific fit.

identity_crosswalk.method: Versioned exact matching may generate candidates only from an authority-accepted name or admitted authority alias. coverage_expectation.denominator_rule: pilot records with at least one reviewed exact COD-to-mineral crosswalk
coverage_expectation.useful_yield_gate: At least 95% of eligible records retain a structure citation and all locatable space-group/unit-cell observations without flattening distinct conditions.

units_definitions.policy: Use the bound Draft 2020-12 value schemas and official IUCr/COD definitions. Preserve original CIF lexemes and source tags, parse uncertainty without rounding, require all six unit-cell parameters, keep temperature and pressure condition kinds separate, and route CIF '?' or '.' to extraction outcomes rather than values.

update_semantics.correction_behavior: Records are revisioned; later revisions do not silently replace frozen claims.
update_semantics.deletion_behavior: A missing, withdrawn, or error-marked live record triggers review and may withdraw or supersede its public claim while retaining the prior claim in audit history.
update_semantics.required_action: Pin COD ID and revision or freeze a named bulk snapshot for each release.

rights.attribution: Acknowledge the original structure authors and COD record even though the database is CC0.

reproducibility.required_snapshot: Freeze query/configuration, raw response bytes or bulk revision, per-record revision, and SHA-256 before staging.

cod_crystal_observations.conflict_policy: Store every qualified observation separately. Never average cells or silently choose a species-wide value; public preference requires review.

review_burden.required_review: Review every crosswalk and all pilot observations; verify conditions, uncertainty, space-group notation, and citation locators.

cod_crystal_observations.decision_reason: Rights, access, identifiers, locators, and the three private-pilot value contracts are defined. Reproducibility, reviewed crosswalks, extraction results, claim-only ingestion, runtime lifecycle gates, and the frozen pilot must still pass before admission or public use.
